name: Basic Fishing Rod
summary: A simple wooden rod. Can land easy and medium-difficulty fish.

name: Silver Fishing Rod
summary: Sturdy alloy rod. Can pull in hard-difficulty fish.

name: Gold Fishing Rod
summary: Master-crafted rod. Can battle legendary catches.

name: Warm Stew
summary: Comforting food. Endurance +2 next battle. Requires bear hide + ice crystal — gather, buy, or harvest from Pocket Haven.

name: Frostcap Skewer
summary: Light field food. Perception +2 next battle. Cooked from a Frostcap mushroom dusted with sprite essence.

name: Hunter's Brew
summary: A bracing brew. Strength +2 next battle. Trophy-grade ingredients only.

name: Fresh Fish
summary: Raw fish. Cook at a station for a stamina buff.

name: Silver Trout
summary: A glittering trout. Eat raw for +1 Agility next battle, or cook for a longer agility surge.

name: Coral Snapper
summary: Reef-fresh fish. Cook for sustained HP regen.

name: Void Eel
summary: Wriggling deep-water predator. Cooking unlocks a magic-power surge.

name: Mire Catfish
summary: Surprisingly tasty once cooked. Grants poison resistance.

name: Emberfin Pike
summary: Hunts in molten currents. Spicy. Cook to boost fire damage.

name: Lantern Jelly
summary: Glowing jelly. Cook to enhance vision range.

name: Thunder Carp
summary: Static-charged carp. Cook for a lightning-damage boost.

name: Moonlit Koi
summary: Legendary. Cooked, grants +1 to all stats.

name: Dragon Tuna
summary: Legendary. Cooked, fills 50% of the ultimate meter.

name: Scrap Stew
summary: Whatever was left. Confers disease resistance.

name: Starcruiser Squid
summary: Cyber-bio squid. Cook to enhance tech damage.

name: Frostcap Stew
summary: A discoverable recipe. Combine ice crystal + sprite dust + bear hide and cook to discover Frostcap Stew. Endurance +3 next battle.

name: Hunter's Pie
summary: A discoverable recipe. Combine two bear claws and a wolf pelt to discover Hunter's Pie. Strength +3 next battle.

name: Jester's Soufflé
summary: A discoverable recipe. Combine a memory shard and three sprite dust to discover Jester's Soufflé. Luck +4 next battle. Perfect cook adds +1.

name: Basic Tent
summary: Simple camping shelter. Campaign Mode can consume it for a camp rest.

name: Minor Potion
summary: Small healing draught. Campaign Mode tracks it as a manual-use item.

name: Jester Reroll Ticket
summary: A system-shop token for a GM-approved reroll or oracle replacement.

name: Punchline Charm
summary: A tiny charm that laughs at bad odds.

name: Frostbitten Trade Writ
summary: A local writ accepted by special hub vendors.

name: Adventurer's Cloak
summary: A warm travelling cloak. Slightly helps dodging.

name: Chimera Fang Dagger
summary: Forged from a chimera's fang. Drains life and scorches.

name: Frost Staff
summary: A simple staff channeling ice magic.

name: Frostfire Core
summary: The dual-element heart of the Frostfire Chimera. Radiates impossible warmth and cold.

name: Healer's Pendant
summary: A pendant that strengthens the wearer's mana reserves.

name: Hunter's Blade
summary: Garr's well-maintained hunting knife.

name: Leather Armor
summary: Basic leather protection.

name: Lucky Coin
summary: Found in Bin's pocket on arrival. Suspiciously warm.

name: Rusty Sword
summary: A chipped, dull blade. Better than fists. Barely.

name: Thunder
summary: Bowy's beloved crossbow. Named Thunder. Do NOT touch it.

name: Warm Boots
summary: Fur-lined boots. Essential in Frostbitten.

name: Bear Claw
summary: Bear Claw material drop (Rare).

name: Bear Hide
summary: Bear Hide material drop (Uncommon).

name: Frost Fang
summary: Frost Fang material drop (Uncommon).

name: Ice Crystal
summary: Ice Crystal material drop (Uncommon).

name: Grass Clippings
summary: Cut from Pocket Haven grass. Useful for simple fertilizer.

name: Basic Fertilizer
summary: A simple soil booster for Pocket Haven crops.

name: Memory Shard
summary: Catalyst used to rank up passives.

name: Sprite Dust
summary: Sprite Dust material drop (Common).

name: Wolf Pelt
summary: Wolf Pelt material drop (Common).

name: Burnice's Flare Carbine
summary: A scavenged launcher tuned for flare bolts and short burn bursts. Light enough for rooftop fights.

name: Burnice's Scavenger Jacket
summary: A reinforced jacket stitched with route tape, patch plates, and just enough padding to matter.

name: Burnice's Route Badge
summary: A clipped route badge marked with fallback arrows and fuel notes. Helps Burnice pace longer runs.
